messages:
Sam (PM): quick sync — we need a concrete shape for the model capability handshake by EOD. customers keep asking: can I query supported tools, streaming, max_tokens, and fallback variants in one call?
Maya (Eng): +1. propose a single discovery endpoint: GET /v1/models/:id/capabilities. returns advertised flags, tools array, limits, and compatibility matrix.
Devin (SRE): important: response must be small and cacheable. TTL for control plane caches = 5m default, longer for enterprise. also need a light mechanism for rate-limited clients.
Elle (ML): we should include qualitative caveats (e.g., partial streaming support) and a "compatibility score" for function calling vs rerank, otherwise SDKs will over-index features.
introspect-bot: automated note: example response schema proposed below.
Maya (Eng): putting a compact example here — this is intentionally minimal so clients can make quick routing decisions.
Maya (Eng): ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-zeta-1",
  "version": "2026-03-10",
  "flags": {
    "streaming": true,
    "function_calling": "partial",
    "structured_output": true,
    "rerank": "approximate"
  },
  "tools": [
    {"name": "search", "mode": "sync"},
    {"name": "sql_exec", "mode": "async", "max_concurrency": 4}
  ],
  "limits": {"max_input_tokens": 12000, "max_response_tokens": 4096},
  "fallbacks": ["redwood-zeta-1-quant", "redwood-eta-1-small"]
}
```
Sam (PM): this is helpful. quick questions: 1) "function_calling": "partial" — how should clients interpret partial? 2) do we expose token budgets per-route?
Elle (ML): partial = supports function schemas with limitations: e.g., nested arrays >3 levels may be lossy, and streaming of function responses isn't guaranteed. We'll document exact edge cases.
Devin (SRE): per-route budgets should be an opt-in header in the discovery payload only for enterprise accounts. keep default discovery free of billing details.
Maya (Eng): implementation notes: server will populate a compact binary hash for model capabilities to allow fast equality checks: `cap_hash`. clients can compare and avoid re-parsing. plus `cache_control` header.
Sam (PM): launch criteria proposal (high level):
- Discovery endpoint exists and passes synthetic compatibility suite (unit + integration).
- SDKs (py/js) can parse flags and choose fallback in <50ms on cold start.
- Docs + migration guide for clients that currently introspect behavior via feature probes.
Maya (Eng): prioritized scope for MVP: flags: streaming (bool), function_calling (enum minimal/partial/full), structured_output (bool), rerank (enum none/approx/precise), tools (list with modes), limits (tokens). No compatibility matrix for MVP — that's V2.
Elle (ML): also need an eval gating rule: if a new model advertises `structured_output: true`, it must pass the structured-output suite (10 representative prompts) with >=95% schema conformity before the flag flips.
Sam (PM): rollout plan: canary to internal customers -> opt-in beta -> GA. automatic fallback policy must be configurable per account (on/off).
Devin (SRE): Ops checklist: tracing hooks for discovery calls, rate limiting, and a "deprecation" header when flags change with a 30-day notice window.
Maya (Eng): client SDK example (pseudo):
```js
const cap = await client.models.capabilities('redwood-zeta-1');
if (!cap.flags.streaming) { useNonStreamingPath(); } else { streamReply(); }
if (cap.flags.function_calling !== 'none') { enableFunctions(cap.tools); }
```
Sam (PM): outstanding trade-offs for product discussion: do we include a "quality_score" per feature (helps smart routing) or leave routing to the control plane? opinions?
Elle (ML): quality_score is valuable, but it's brittle. better to provide a short-lived metric (last_eval_hash + score) and let the control plane/eval service surface stable recommendations.
Maya (Eng): agree with Elle. put quality metadata behind enterprise opt-in in v1.
Devin (SRE): reminder: any metadata exposing eval results must be scrubbed of PII and stored with retention policy.
Sam (PM): action items:
- Maya: implement MVP response shape + `cap_hash` and caching by EOW.
- Elle: define the structured-output eval suite and pass criteria.
- Devin: add discovery tracing + deprecation header handling.
- Sam: draft launch checklist and enterprise opt-in docs.
Maya (Eng): will post a PR with the open API schema tomorrow.
Sam (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups in roadmap board. :thumbsup:
Maya (Eng): :thumbsup:
Elle (ML): noted.
Devin (SRE): adding checklist to runbook.
